Matt Cohen, novelist, short story writer, poet, author of children’s books (born 30 December 1942 in Kingston, ON; died 2 December 1999 in Toronto, ON). Winner of the Governor General’s Award and a founding member of the Writers’ Union of Canada, Matt Cohen was a prolific and acclaimed writer, the author of more than 20 works of fiction.Education and Career
